key_catalyst: U.S.-Iran military escalation and closure of the Strait of Hormuz sends oil prices surging
reasoning: The U.S.-Iran military escalation over the Strait of Hormuz is an active, escalating geopolitical shock with no resolution in sight — Iran has declared the strait closed and oil has surged 4%+, directly feeding into rising Treasury yields and Fed tightening expectations. The Asian semiconductor selloff (KOSPI down 7.6-9%, SK Hynix -15%) confirms the market has not absorbed this risk, and with only a -1.19% pre-market move, further downside is likely as the conflict remains unresolved.
